claims.claim: GPT‑6 Sol and GPT‑6 Luna reduce API prices by 50% compared with their GPT‑5.6 promotional pricing.
GPT‑6 Sol at xhigh effort outperforms Claude Opus 5 at max effort at just 9% of Opus 5’s cost per task on AutomationBench.
At high effort, GPT‑6 Luna improves on its predecessor by 5.4 percentage points at 58% lower cost per task on AutomationBench.
GPT‑6 Sol exceeds Claude Fable 5.1 at far lower cost and even bests low-effort GPT‑6 Astra on AutomationBench.
GPT‑6 Sol and Luna were trained with similar methods as GPT‑6 Astra, bringing advances in professional work, factuality, coding, computer use, and alignment.
GPT‑6 Astra continues to be the best model across the board, with GPT‑6 Sol and Luna offering more cost-efficient alternatives.

delta: 50% lower API prices vs GPT-5.6 Sol and Luna
faster output speed (104.4 vs 72.6 tokens/sec for Sol)
improved caching pricing (90% off for cached input)
